This is a Goblin Deck Ive been building for a while, I know it is not the best deck, but think is quite good, the idea of this deck, is to finish the game, in the first few turns, if I dont make it, so there is Krenko, Mob Boss and Hellrider to do it. I want some opinions to improve it, so I hope you can help me. Thanks
